description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named SubunitCountPair within the OrangeHRM dashboard module. It encapsulates a Subunit entity and an associated count, providing constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: SubunitCountPair
classes.description: A data transfer object that pairs a Subunit entity with an integer count, providing constructor and getter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubunitCountPair with a Subunit instance and a count.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the Subunit object stored in this pair.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count associated with the Subunit.
